newsitem.title: EGYPT: Delta International Bank raising capital.
newsitem.headline: Delta International Bank raising capital.

text.p: Egypt's Delta International Bank said on Monday it planned to increase its issued capital to 300 million pounds ($88 million) from 180 million.
The board will put the proposal to a meeting of shareholders in Cairo on June 30.

A bank official told Reuters existing shareholders would be invited to contribute to part of the capital increase and the rest would probably be offered for public subscription. She could not say how much would be available to the public.
The bank is also proposing to increase its authorised capital to 500.25 million pounds from 200 million.
